nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
kind: 10 câu hỏi – đáp về gia đình
L: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Yes, I have an older sister and a younger brother.
What does your dad do for a living?
He's a bus driver. He's been one for twenty years.
Do you get along with your sister?
Most of the time, but we argue about the bathroom.
Who do you take after, your mom or your dad?
I take after my mom. We both love cooking.
In the countryside, about two hours from here.
How often do you see your cousins?
Every Tet. We all get together at my grandma's.
Pretty close. We have dinner together every night.
Are you the oldest in your family?
No, I'm the middle child. I have to share everything.
Do you still live with your parents?
Yes, for now. I'm saving up to rent my own place.
She's very kind, but she's strict about homework.
